said Doug Ostermann, Chief Financial Officer, Versigent. &#8220;Based on our year-to-date results and current macroeconomic outlook, we are raising the midpoint and tightening our full-year net sales and Free Cash Flow</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> guidance ranges, as well as tightening our Adjusted EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> range. For forward-looking non-GAAP measures, the Company does not provide a reconciliation of such forward-looking measure to the most directly comparable U.S. GAAP measure because to do so would be potentially misleading and not practical given the difficulty of projecting event-driven transactional and other non-core operating items in any future period. The magnitude of these items, however, may be significant. </font></div></div></div><div id="i58de659e75214fe9a2b99d20b4138bb3_10"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:42.75pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#cd7925;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Third Quarter 2026 Results</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Versigent delivered third quarter 2026 net sales of $2,450 million, an increase of 7.2% compared to the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted Net Sales Growth</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">, which excludes the impact of year-over-year commodity and foreign currency movements, was approximately 1% despite lower global automotive production.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Net income attributable to Versigent was $102 million, compared to $109 million in the prior-year quarter. The quarter included higher interest expense associated with the Company&#8217;s first quarter 2026 debt financing, partially offset by lower income tax expense. Net income margin was 4.2%, down 60 basis points year-over-year.  Diluted EPS was $1.41 and Adjusted Diluted EPS</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> was $1.91 for the third quarter of 2026.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Adjusted EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> increased 10.9% year-over-year to $275 million. Adjusted EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> margin was 11.2%, up 40 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025, reflecting continued strong operational execution amid a significant number of program launches during the quarter, together with favorable net pricing and foreign currency impacts, partially offset by higher commodity costs. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Interest expense was $36 million in the quarter, compared to de minimis for the third quarter of 2025, principally due to the Company&#8217;s senior notes and credit facility issued in the first quarter of 2026. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Income tax expense was $35 million, compared to $54 million in the prior-year period. The decrease was primarily driven by a lower effective tax rate in the third quarter of 2026, as the prior-year quarter included higher net discrete tax expenses, primarily related to valuation allowance adjustments.</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Net cash provided by operating activities was $225 million, up slightly year-over-year. Capital expenditures increased to $55 million from $44 million in the prior-year quarter. Free Cash Flow</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> was $170 million, compared to $179 million in the prior-year quarter, primarily reflecting increased capital expenditures associated with higher launch activity in the second half of 2026. Free Cash Flow</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> for the third quarter of 2026 included $11 million of separation-related costs, compared to $7 million in the prior-year quarter.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#cd7925;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Dividend</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On November 3, 2026, the Company's Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.13 per ordinary share, payable on December 17, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The declaration and payment of future dividends are subject to the discretion of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors and will depend on Building on a legacy of engineering excellence and trusted partnerships, Versigent delivers versatile, intelligent solutions engineered to unlock greater capabilities for our customers. Powering one in six passenger vehicles in production today, Versigent&#8217;s high performance signal, power, and data distribution systems are trusted by industry leaders across automotive, commercial vehicles, agriculture and energy storage. With engineering and manufacturing centers on four continents and operations in more than 25 countries, Versigent&#8217;s approximately 138,000 employees match global scale with regional responsiveness to deliver consistent quality and reliable performance connecting the world to faster, smarter and safer experiences. Visit </font><font style="color:#0057b7;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">www.versigent.com</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#cd7925;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Use of Non&#8209;GAAP Financial Measures</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In addition to its reported results calculated in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (&#8220;U.S. GAAP&#8221;), this press release also includes non-GAAP financial measures, including Adjusted Net Sales Growth, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Adjusted Diluted EPS, and Free Cash Flow. style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">VERSIGENT PLC</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">RECONCILIATIONS OF NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">(Unaudited)</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In this press release the Company has provided information regarding certain non-GAAP financial measures, including Adjusted Net Sales Growth, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Adjusted Diluted EPS and Free Cash Flow. Such non-GAAP financial measures are defined and discussed in greater detail and reconciled to the most directly comparable U.S. GAAP financial measure in the following schedules. Non-GAAP financial measures should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for our reported results prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP and, as calculated, may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies.</font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div id="i58de659e75214fe9a2b99d20b4138bb3_31"></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted Net Sales Growth</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#58; Adjusted Net Sales Growth is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company&#8217;s financial performance which management believes is useful to investors in assessing the Company&#8217;s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding U.S. GAAP measure, provides improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company&#8217;s core operating performance and which may obscure underlying business results and trends. Our management utilizes Adjusted Net Sales Growth in its financial decision-making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted Net Sales Growth is defined as the change in reported net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on net sales from foreign currency and commodity movements.</font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><table style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td><td colspan="3" style="display:none"></td></tr></table></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">8</font></div></div></div><div id="i58de659e75214fe9a2b99d20b4138bb3_34"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#58; Adjusted EBITDA is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company&#8217;s financial performance which management believes is useful to investors in assessing the Company&#8217;s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding U.S. GAAP measure, provides improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company&#8217;s core operating performance and which may obscure underlying business results and trends. Our management utilizes Adjusted EBITDA in its financial decision-making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income (loss) attributable to Versigent before depreciation and amortization (including asset impairments), interest expense, income tax expense (benefit), net (loss) income attributable to noncontrolling interest, other expense (income), net, equity income (loss), net of tax, restructuring, separation costs related to the Spin-Off, other acquisition and portfolio project costs (which includes costs incurred to integrate acquired businesses and to plan and execute product portfolio transformation actions, including business and product acquisitions and divestitures) and other special items. Adjusted EBITDA margin represents Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of net sales.</font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:100.000%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"></td><td style="width:41.736%"></td><td Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">9</font></div></div></div><div id="i58de659e75214fe9a2b99d20b4138bb3_37"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Diluted EPS</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#58; Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Diluted EPS, which are non-GAAP financial measures, are presented as supplemental measures of the Company&#8217;s financial performance which management believes are useful to investors in assessing the Company&#8217;s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding U.S. GAAP measure, provide improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company&#8217;s core operating performance and which may obscure underlying business results and trends. Management utilizes Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Diluted EPS in its financial decision-making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted Net Income represents net income (loss) attributable to Versigent before amortization, restructuring, separation costs related to the Spin-Off, other acquisition and portfolio project costs (which includes costs incurred to integrate acquired businesses and to plan and execute product portfolio transformation actions, including business and product acquisitions and divestitures) and other special items, including the tax impact thereon. Adjusted Diluted EPS is defined as Adjusted Net Income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding for the period. </font></div><div style="text-align:center"><table Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:115%;text-decoration:underline">Free Cash Flow</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">&#58; Free Cash Flow is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company&#8217;s liquidity, which is consistent with the basis and manner in which management presents financial information for the purpose of making internal operating decisions, evaluating its liquidity and determining appropriate capital allocation strategies. Management believes this measure is useful to investors to understand how the Company&#8217;s core operating activities generate and use cash. Free Cash Flow is defined as net cash provided by (used in) operating activities less capital expenditures. The calculation of Free Cash Flow does not reflect cash used to service debt, pay dividends or repurchase shares and therefore, does not necessarily reflect funds available for investment or other discretionary uses.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:100.000%"><tr><td
